desc: Characterize valid graphs uniquely by BFS layers: only same/consecutive-layer edges are allowed, and every non-root-layer vertex needs a predecessor neighbor.
Derive fixed-layer transition factors: within-layer edges and nonempty predecessor-neighborhood cross edges.

Derive a complete implementable DP using exponential generating functions over BFS layer sizes, with exact transition formulas, state bounds, initialization/termination, complexity for N≤30, and pseudocode suitable for Python.
Implement the polynomial DP modulo P, including factorial/inverse-factorial label weights and output extraction.
Prove unique counting and validate against the supplied samples.
